# monotaur_label (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur label. Labels are tags that can be attached to components, monitors, and calendar events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_label" "production" {
  text  = "production"
  color = "#E53935"
  icon  = "🚩"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `text` (String) The display text of the label.

### Optional

- `calendar_event_ids` (List of String) IDs of calendar events associated with this label.
- `color` (String) Optional hex colour code for the label (e.g. `#FF5733`).
- `component_ids` (List of String) IDs of components associated with this label.
- `icon` (String) Optional icon for the label. Must be a single Unicode Extended Pictographic codepoint (an emoji), e.g. `🚩`.
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) IDs of monitors associated with this label.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the label was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the label (assigned by the API).
- `name` (String) The computed machine-readable name of the label (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the label was last updated (assigned by the API).
- `value` (String) The computed value of the label (assigned by the API).
